purpose: Teach: スタンプ/コロッケ/たこ焼き/シロ/タケ/カブ/みそ/ルータ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 店で、スタンプカード、集めてるの。
lines.en: I've been collecting the stamp cards at that shop.
lines.style: Warm, open sharing. Slight lift on 「集めてる」 — taking quiet pride in the small habit. Conversational, direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。コロッケ、揚げ立てが美味しいよね。
lines.en: Yeah. The croquettes are best when they're fresh-fried.
lines.style: Knowing nod in the voice. Soft but certain — this is the kind of thing she remembers about what people like. Gentle agreement, no elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夜店で、たこ焼き、必ず買う。
lines.en: At the festival, I always buy takoyaki without fail.
lines.style: Bright, animated recall. A little faster tempo on 「必ず」 — the warmth of a small ritual. Light, almost nostalgic.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの愛犬、シロ、覚えてる?
lines.style: Shift into something softer, more distant. A question that carries weight. Slight pause before the name, like holding something tender. Wistful but grounded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 庭のタケ、春に芽が出る、楽しみ。
lines.en: When the bamboo in the garden puts out spring shoots, I look forward to it.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Slow pace on the image — letting the listener see it too. Tenderness for the small seasonal anticipations. Trailing off slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カブの煮物、お母さん、得意なの。
lines.en: My mom's really good at making turnip stew.
lines.style: Warm, grounded. A small smile in the voice — the kind of thing you mention because it matters quietly. Not showy, just present. Settled tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: みそ汁、毎朝、欠かさない。
lines.en: I never skip miso soup in the morning.
lines.style: Soft, almost ritual-like in cadence. Quiet certainty — this is the anchor of the day. No variation, no drama. Just the gentle reliability of her own habits.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 家のルータ、新しくしたいけど、まだ。
lines.en: I want to replace the router at home, but haven't gotten around to it yet.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly self-aware. A thin smile — acknowledging the small incompleteness without urgency. Quiet resignation mixed with gentle humor. Fade at the end.
